humanUi.mode: deterministic conversational reasoning assistant backed by the first-class item/acquisition graph
humanUi.localStorage: optional and disposable; stores username, latest normalized player snapshot (public or user-entered) and recent questions when available
humanUi.interimPlayerLoader: official public profile HTML; skill level/XP only when browser cross-origin policy permits
humanUi.manualSkills: Optional username; enter known whole-number levels; blanks and XP stay unknown. Clearly labelled user-entered, not verified.
humanUi.refreshFailure: Retain previous same-player snapshot with warning and timestamp; never reuse across different usernames; ignore superseded responses.
humanUi.visualStyle: FlatMMO-inspired charcoal panels, brown secondary controls, green primary actions, cream text and monospace headings; no external images/fonts required.
humanUi.manualFormLayout: Bounded dialog with independently scrolling fields and persistent Save/Cancel footer; two skill columns at phone widths.
humanUi.queryEngine: v1.9 browser-side structured query interpreter: candidate entity resolution, goals, composable constraints, query planning, graph traversal, deterministic deductions and conversational composition; no LLM required
humanUi.conversationContext: Keeps a bounded semantic turn stack in memory, including subject, goal, source-role references and applicable constraints, so follow-ups can inherit or explicitly replace prior context; disposable with the session
humanUi.inlineLevels: Skill levels explicitly stated in a question may be used for that answer only; they do not overwrite the saved/manual player snapshot
humanUi.acquisitionIndex: flatmmo-items.json is authoritative for item-specific acquisition/use questions. It normalizes monster drops, world nodes, production, shops, Stealing, Farming, quests, spirits, events, bundles and explicit NPC services/trades; unknown rates/currencies stay unknown.
humanUi.reasoningEngine: Builds a structured query object from the question, applies method/area/skill/price/access constraints, plans a deterministic graph query, and records an explicit user-visible reasoning trace
humanUi.constraintReasoning: Supports acquisition-method include/exclude constraints, non-combat/non-quest/no-spend filters, area filters, stated skill levels, numeric shop-price caps and documented access conditions
humanUi.recursiveProduction: Expands documented production recipes recursively with cycle protection; terminal inputs and missing intermediate recipes remain explicit rather than assumed
humanUi.explainability: A follow-up such as Why? explains the previous deterministic interpretation, constraints, conclusions, evidence and limits; it does not expose hidden model reasoning because the site has no model reasoning layer
humanUi.rankingPolicy: Uses measurable comparisons such as numeric shop price or documented skill gate when requested; qualitative best/easiest/fastest prompts ask for a criterion instead of inventing an overall ranking

coverage.armourResourceCosts: deep-normalized for smithable melee, craftable archery, and enchantable mage armour
coverage.questProcedures: 19 normalized core quest records; 2 additional observation-backed quest placeholders have incomplete procedures/rewards
coverage.beds: first-class index for explicitly documented bed locations
coverage.internalRooms: detailed for 13/14 areas; Desert currently partial
coverage.entityGraph: quest steps <-> rooms/NPCs/monsters; monsters <-> rooms; rooms <-> resource nodes
coverage.monsterRoomLinks: 52/82 monster records linked to 82 exact room/access references
coverage.questRoomLinks: 55/104 quest steps have one or more exact room IDs; all 104 carry structured area/room link state
coverage.bedSemantics: bedStatus distinguishes documented beds from rooms where a bed is merely not documented
coverage.mechanicsRules: 12 explicit rules/readiness records including observed Sleep/Run behavior and calculation blocks
coverage.aiContext: schema 1.7; merges 2 observed quest placeholders, embeds the first-class item/acquisition graph, and retains mechanics rules plus player-source and refresh policies
coverage.playerAwareness: Skill-level checks from public profiles or explicitly labelled manual levels. Inventory, bank, equipment and quest completion remain unknown.
coverage.itemGraph: 588 first-class item records; 1168 normalized acquisition routes; 199 items with structured uses
coverage.shopInventories: item-specific rows from the current Shops page plus explicit item-named area/NPC shop records; generic shop descriptions are not promoted to complete inventories
coverage.stealing: pickpocket, stall, one-time chest and Rogue chest item-source records normalized where the current Stealing page names the item
coverage.farming: seed-to-crop and selected tree/fruit-tree planting relationships normalized from current Farming data; unknown yields remain unknown

safeNow: recipe material totals already represented in structured equipment data
constraint-aware multi-source acquisition filtering and discovery
lowest documented skill-gate comparison within matching acquisition routes
numeric shop-price comparison when price and currency are explicitly structured
recursive production dependency expansion from documented recipes with explicit gaps
deterministic explanation of the previous query interpretation, constraints and conclusions
pendingUserObservation: Sleep Point costs and zero-Sleep behaviour by activity type
pendingPlayerApi: other player snapshot fields exposed by the official API

knownIssues: Desert internal-room coverage remains partial; Desert quest steps are intentionally mostly area-only.
30 monster records have no exact room link.
Some bootstrap monster area labels conflict with current room-page evidence; both are retained rather than silently overwritten.
Room adjacency remains incomplete where the wiki does not explicitly state a route.
Monster bootstrap mirror still awaits official refresh.
Feeding The Homeless and Atlas Crown are now named observation-backed records, but their full procedures/rewards remain incomplete.
The interim public-profile loader can be blocked by browser cross-origin policy; official player API integration is pending.
Exact combat hit/damage formulas remain unresolved, so exact DPS, kill time, survivability and recommended combat levels are intentionally blocked.
Agility level 1-19 Run-step progression and exact zero-Sleep behavior by activity remain pending observations.
Known source conflicts remain retained in verification notes.
The v1.9 reasoning interpreter is deterministic and finite; unusual or genuinely ambiguous phrasing may still require a more specific question.
The item graph is substantially expanded but not exhaustive; absence of a source/use means not documented in the current snapshot, not proof that it does not exist in FlatMMO.
Some Stealing stall drop chances are shown as unknown on the current wiki and remain unknown in the Companion.
Prospector shop price values are preserved from the shop table but its currency column is not labelled for those rows, so the Companion does not assume Coins.
Qualitative route terms such as easiest, fastest and best are not assigned an overall ranking without a measurable criterion supported by the data.
Recursive production expansion can expose missing intermediate recipes/acquisition records; those remain explicit knowledge gaps rather than inferred steps.
updatePolicy: Manually maintained static snapshot. The deployment workflow publishes committed files; it does not refresh game data or player snapshots. AI retrieval is optional/best-effort.
